label: Strict forwardness of eligible exercise edges
term: strict forwardness of eligible exercise edges
definition: Every selected exercise edge C e f satisfies clock e < clock f on the supplied order of clock values. The clock values belong to the particular eligible exercise tokens. C ranges over the fixed exercise roster, including exercises of distinct bearers.
note: The existing strict-forward clause of the temporal direction profiles, applied to the selected exercise relation. Its application to eligible esse-supply exercises remains open and requires an order-preserving clock on those very tokens.
